meta.title: Xiaomi 17T Pro / MediaTek Dimensity 9500 hardware specs
meta.rules: Every field has value, unit, source, and status in {confirmed, unconfirmed, unknown}. Official sources preferred. Do not invent unpublished figures.
meta.unknowns_pass_2026_11_12: Second research pass resolving UNKNOWN/UNCONFIRMED fields; see unknowns-resolved.md. Added keys: confidence, resolved_on, searched_2026_11_12.

launch_date.notes: Also Xiaomi Global event: Vienna, 28.05.2026, 14:00 GMT+2.

model_number.notes: Printed on Xiaomi Taiwan official spec page (產品型號：2602EPTC0G, NCC ID CCAF265G0140T0). Also GSMArena.

rear_cover.notes: Reputable outlet (GSMArena review also). Not stated on Xiaomi official spec sheet. Treated as outlet-confirmed in the dossier narrative; status unconfirmed officially. | 2026-11-12: Xiaomi lists Gorilla Glass 7i only under Display (front). IT之家 hands-on describes the back as AG matte glass; only GSMArena names GG7i for the back. Still single-source for the rear glass grade.
rear_cover.searched_2026_11_12: Xiaomi Global/TW/CN spec pages, IT之家 review (ithome.com/0/961/522.htm), Notebookcheck review, GSMArena

frame.notes: Two independent hands-on sources: IT之家 review (铝合金材质, 雾面喷砂) and GSMArena (aluminum frame). Not on the Xiaomi spec sheet.

ingress_protection.notes: IEC 60529 lab: 1.5 m static freshwater, 30 min, ΔT ≤ 5 °C.

cooling_materials.value: Vapor chamber (VC heat sink) + graphite sheets + graphite-copper foil (front camera) + thermal grease applied to frame; marketed as Xiaomi 3D IceLoop
cooling_materials.notes: Xiaomi official repair manual (ERP, 53 pp): 'Lift the graphite sheet', 'Check that the VC heat sink is not wrinkled or deformed', 'apply thermal grease to the frame', 'Apply graphite copper foil to the front camera'. VC area: see cooling_vc_area_mm2.

fingerprint.notes: Xiaomi China official page meta lists 光学指纹 (optical fingerprint); Notebookcheck and GSMArena also say optical. Resolves conflict #13.

display_type.value: AMOLED, flat, flexible, on-cell full lamination

color_depth.notes: 68 billion colors. FAQ incorrectly says 8-bit; see conflicts.

pwm_hz.notes: Two independent measurements: GSMArena lists 3840 Hz PWM; Notebookcheck measured a 3,846 Hz component plus a 120 Hz base frequency at minimum brightness (15.5% amplitude) despite Xiaomi calling it DC dimming. Model/app should show both 120 Hz and ~3.84 kHz.

panel_supplier.notes: TCL CSOT publicly announced it supplies the Xiaomi 17T series displays (17T Pro: 6.83-in 144 Hz 2772x1280, 3500 nits). Xiaomi CN meta also states 新型红色发光主材 (new red emitter host material). Huawei Central calls the panel LTPS OLED. Exact OLED emitter stack (e.g. M-series code) not published.

ram_type_rate_mbps.notes: Below SoC max of 10667 Mbps; device bin.

storage_interface.notes: Device lane count (2 vs 4) not stated by Xiaomi.

ufs_lane_count_device.notes: 2026-11-12: Not stated by Xiaomi (Global/TW/CN), Notebookcheck, GSMArena, IT之家. Measured: Notebookcheck AndroBench seq read 3021.5 MB/s, seq write 2770 MB/s, 4K rand read 414 MB/s (512 GB unit) — below a 2-lane HS-G5 ceiling (~4.2 GB/s), so the measurement cannot discriminate 2- vs 4-lane. SoC supports 4-lane (MediaTek). Only a teardown/UFS device-descriptor dump would settle it.
ufs_lane_count_device.searched_2026_11_12: Xiaomi spec pages, NBC review AndroBench table, GSMArena, IT之家, web search for "17T Pro" 4-lane/2-lane

ram_sku_16gb.value: 16GB+512GB exists in China (国行) only; global SKUs are 12GB only
ram_sku_16gb.notes: IT之家: 国行 Pro adds 16GB+512GB; IT之家 review unit was 16GB+512GB; Huawei Central lists CN pricing 16+512 = ¥5099. Xiaomi Global/TW list 12GB SKUs only. Resolves conflict #7 (market-dependent, not an error).

dram_vendor.notes: 2026-11-12: No 17T Pro teardown/X-ray found (iFixit, TechInsights, Kurnal, PBK, JerryRig searched). Xiaomi repair manual does not name components. TechInsights found Samsung LPDDR5X stacked on MT6993Z in Vivo X300 Pro / OPPO Find X9 Pro only — not transferable.
dram_vendor.searched_2026_11_12: TechInsights, Kurnal, iFixit, Xiaomi ERP manual, web search "17T Pro LPDDR5X Samsung/Micron/SK hynix"

battery_chemistry.notes: Spec: silicon-carbon battery; FAQ: lithium polymer. Complementary descriptions.

wireless_reverse_w.notes: FAQ only; not on official spec sheet. | 2026-11-12: Official spec sheets (Global, TW) list only 22.5 W WIRED reverse; GSMArena lists 22.5 W reverse wired only; Notebookcheck mentions no reverse wireless. 5 W reverse wireless rests solely on the UK FAQ (which also contains other errors). Treat as doubtful.
wireless_reverse_w.searched_2026_11_12: Xiaomi Global/TW specs, UK FAQ, GSMArena, Notebookcheck

included_cable_usb.notes: Cable spec, not necessarily phone SuperSpeed.

phone_usb_data.value: USB 2.0 (USB Type-C, 480 Mb/s class), OTG, no DisplayPort video out
phone_usb_data.notes: Notebookcheck measured 23.16 MB/s copying to a Samsung T7 (USB 3.2 Gen 2) SSD and states USB 2.0 without video output; GSMArena: USB Type-C 2.0, OTG.

pmic.notes: 2026-11-12: No 17T Pro board-level teardown found. MediaTek MT6363/MT6373 SPMI PMICs are documented in upstream Linux for recent Dimensity platforms, but no source ties a specific PMIC to this phone.
pmic.searched_2026_11_12: TechInsights, Kurnal, Linux dt-bindings (MT6363/MT6373), Xiaomi ERP, web search

battery_si_c_ratio.notes: Xiaomi official poster (via IT之家): 7000 mAh 小米金沙江电池, highest Xiaomi silicon content to date 16%, ≥80% capacity after 1600 cycles. Basis (wt% of anode active material vs whole anode) not specified. Dual-cell confirmed in repair manual. Cathode chemistry still unpublished.

cooling_vc_area_mm2.notes: China launch coverage (Huawei Central, citing Xiaomi launch imagery): 5500 mm² VC. Not on Xiaomi Global/TW spec text. A secondary claim of 4637 mm² (repair-parts blog) is unverified and conflicts.

battery_cycle_rating.value: ≥80% after 1600 cycles (Xiaomi CN claim); EU label: 1000 cycles
battery_cycle_rating.notes: Xiaomi CN poster via IT之家 (1600 cycles). EU energy label summary on GSMArena: Class A, 70:55h endurance, 1000 cycles, free-fall class B, repairability class C.

transistor_architecture.notes: TSMC 3nm family is FinFET. GAA/nanosheet is official on TSMC N2, not N3P.

transistor_count.notes: TechInsights: "packing 30 billion transistors"; MediaTek launch briefing via ZOL: 300亿+ (30B+). Kurnal die analysis lists 30B? and his own cell-library estimate of ~27.3B. Not on MediaTek public spec pages.

die_size_mm2.notes: Kurnal decap measurement: 10.88 mm x 12.92 mm = 140.57 mm², die thickness 200 µm, die mark BHJ11471B (22 FEB 2025), 458 gross die per 300 mm wafer. Notebookcheck quotes ~140.79 mm² from the same die shot. TechInsights die code BHJ11471B matches.

package_this_phone.value: PoP: MT6993Z SoC package (HB MUFPOP, 16.40 x 14.00 mm, 0.455 mm thick, 0.35 mm ball pitch) with LPDDR5X stacked on top — SoC-level design; the 17T Pro unit itself has not been torn down
package_this_phone.notes: Kurnal (package analysis) and TechInsights (PoP with Samsung LPDDR5X in Vivo X300 Pro/OPPO Find X9 Pro). Dimensity 9500 ships as a PoP part, so PoP in the 17T Pro is highly likely, but DRAM vendor/stack in this phone is unverified.

cpu_cluster.value: 1x C1-Ultra 4.21GHz 2MB L2 + 3x C1-Premium 3.5GHz 1MB L2 + 4x C1-Pro 2.7GHz 512KB L2

l1_cache_bytes.value: C1-Ultra: 64 KB L1I + 128 KB L1D; C1-Premium: 64 KB L1I + 64 KB L1D; C1-Pro: 64 KB L1I + 64 KB L1D (C1-Pro size configurable 32/64 KB — 64 KB in D9500 is unconfirmed)
l1_cache_bytes.notes: C1-Ultra/C1-Premium L1 sizes are fixed in Arm TRMs (4-way, 64 B lines). C1-Pro is 32 or 64 KB per Arm TRM; aggregators list 64/64 for D9500. MediaTek "100% bigger L1" matches C1-Ultra L1D 64→128 KB vs Cortex-X925. NOTE: Arm's C1 comparison PDF says C1-Premium 64/128 KB, contradicting the C1-Premium TRM (64 KB L1D) — TRM preferred. Per-core fields added below.

gpu_architecture.value: Arm 5th Gen GPU, tile-based with Deferred Vertex Shading, CSF, RTUv2 on Ultra

gpu_vulkan.notes: Khronos: Mali-G1-Ultra Vulkan 1.4 conformant 2025-12-19. MediaTek also says Vulkan 1.4.

gpu_opengl_es.notes: Arm Mali G1 column: OpenGL ES 1.1–3.2.

gpu_fp32_ops_per_core_per_cycle.notes: Arm counts each FMA as 2 operations. Peak TFLOPS still unknown without official clock.

gpu_clock_mhz.notes: Consistent across aggregators (NanoReview, 91mobiles, c-gpu, spesification) and Kurnal die report ("Mali G1-Ultra MP12 @1.7GHz"). Not on MediaTek/Arm pages; no kernel DT/devfreq dump found. Derived peak FP32 = 12 cores x 256 ops/clk x 1.716 GHz = 5.27 TFLOPS (FMA counted as 2); FP16 = 10.54 TFLOPS.

npu_name.value: MediaTek NPU 990 + Super Efficient CIM NPU

npu_tops.notes: TechInsights: "AI capabilities scale to 100 TOPS"; Counterpoint (from MediaTek briefing): up to 100 TOPS. Precision (INT8 vs FP8/INT4) and whether CIM NPU/SME2 are included are NOT stated. Not on MediaTek public pages.

npu_llm_tokens_per_s.notes: Google Developers Blog (with MediaTek), Dec 2025: Gemma 3n E2B on Dimensity 9500 NPU (Vivo X300 Pro) >1600 tokens/s prefill and 28 tokens/s decode at 4K context. Developer report on MT6993: Qwen3-0.6B a16w8 ~19 ms/token (~53 tok/s) with Google's official .litertlm (genio-community). Model-specific; not a universal number.

npu_context_tokens.notes: On-device long-text capacity vs 32K on Dimensity 9400.

modem.value: 3GPP Rel-17 5G, Sub-6 FR1, 5CC-CA up to 7.4 Gbps DL

mmwave.value: No — integrated modem is Sub-6 (FR1) only; 17T Pro band list has no n257/n258/n260/n261
mmwave.notes: MediaTek spec table lists Sub-6/FR1, 5CC-CA, 7.4 Gbps; Xiaomi Global/TW band lists contain FR1 bands only. MediaTek M90 (FR1+FR2) is a separate modem, not in D9500.

memory_channel_width_bits.notes: 4 x 16-bit LPDDR5X channels per aggregators (NanoReview/PhoneBench/spesification). JEDEC LPDDR5X channels are x16; MediaTek does not publish the controller width.

memory_theoretical_bandwidth_GBps.notes: Derived for the 17T Pro: 9600 MT/s x 64 bit / 8 = 76.8 GB/s (SoC max at 10667 MT/s = 85.3 GB/s). Inherits the unconfirmed 64-bit width.

ufs_41_jedec_peak_GBps.notes: JEDEC wording for M-PHY 5.0 / UniPro 2.0, typical 2-lane ~4.2 GB/s.

l1i_kb_c1_pro.notes: Arm C1-Pro TRM allows 32 or 64 KB (4-way, 64 B lines); 64 KB in D9500 per aggregators (NanoReview/HMC) and consistent with D9400 A720 config; not stated by MediaTek.

l1d_kb_c1_pro.notes: Arm C1-Pro TRM allows 32 or 64 KB (4-way, 64 B lines); 64 KB in D9500 per aggregators (NanoReview/HMC) and consistent with D9400 A720 config; not stated by MediaTek.

c1_ultra_frontend_width.value: 10 MOPs/cycle decode/dispatch, up to 20 µOPs/cycle dispatch; 23 issue pipelines (3 branch, 6 int single-cycle, 2 int multi-cycle, 6 FP/ASIMD 128-bit, 2 load/store, 2 load, 2 store-data)
c1_ultra_frontend_width.notes: Arm C1-Ultra Software Optimization Guide (quoted by jia.je and the LLVM C1-Ultra scheduling model PR #182251). Arm Lumex briefing: stays "10-wide", out-of-order window +25%, up to ~2K instructions in flight, L1I fetch bandwidth +33%. Numeric ROB entry count and pipeline depth are NOT published; LLVM's 320-entry ROB value is explicitly copied from Neoverse V3, do not use.

c1_premium_frontend_width.value: 10 MOPs/cycle dispatch, up to 20 µOPs/cycle; 19 issue pipelines (only 2 FP/ASIMD vs 6 on Ultra)
c1_premium_frontend_width.notes: From Arm C1-Premium Software Optimization Guide as compiled by jia.je.

c1_pro_frontend_width.value: 5 MOPs/cycle dispatch, up to 10 µOPs/cycle; 13 issue pipelines; 2x 0-cycle BTB and 16x 1-cycle BTB capacity vs A725
c1_pro_frontend_width.notes: From Arm C1-Pro SOG/TRM and Arm Lumex C1-Pro blog as compiled by jia.je.

c1_ultra_inflight_instructions.notes: Arm Lumex briefing (ComputerBase): "bis zu ~2K Instruktionen in flight", OoO window +25% vs X925. Approximate, not a ROB entry count.

sve_vector_length_bits.notes: Arm C1-Ultra TRM: SVE with 128-bit vector length + SVE2 (same 128-bit on C1-Premium/C1-Pro).

sme2_streaming_vector_length_bits.notes: Arm C1-SME2 unit TRM: SME/SME2 and Streaming SVE with 512-bit vector length; shared unit in the DSU cluster. Kurnal identifies a 2.91 mm² block with 640 KiB cache in the D9500 CPU cluster as probably the SME2 unit (tentative).

c1_ultra_tlb.value: L1 ITLB 128 entries, L1 DTLB 96 entries, L2 TLB 2048 entries 8-way
c1_ultra_tlb.notes: From Arm C1-Ultra TRM as compiled by jia.je.

gpu_peak_fp32_tflops_derived.notes: Computed: 12 x 256 x 1.716e9. Inherits the unconfirmed clock.

gpu_l2_mb.notes: Kurnal die analysis: "Have 2MiByte L2 Cache". (Arm Lumex reference platform used 4 MB with 14 cores.)

npu_structure.value: NPU 990: 4x MDLA (MediaTek Deep Learning Accelerator) + 2x MVPU (vision/vector processing unit); 4 MiB NPU L2; ~1 MiB per-MDLA cache; NeuroPilot compiler targets --num-mdla 4 --l1-size-kb 7168 for MT6993
npu_structure.notes: Kurnal die analysis (NPU990 12.595 mm² vs APU890 10.414 mm²; MDLA core 1.811 mm²; MVPU core 0.62 mm²; MVPU cache 512 KiB). Compiler flags from Google's official Qwen3-0.6B.mediatek.mt6993.litertlm (genio-community thread). Internal MAC-array dimensions still unpublished.

npu_precisions_documented.value: a16w8 (FP16 activations + INT8 weights) used by Google's official MT6993 LLM bundles; BitNet 1.58-bit supported (MediaTek); INT and FP compute both "doubled" vs D9400 (MediaTek)
npu_precisions_documented.notes: 990-specific INT4/FP8 throughput table still not published.

part_number.notes: Kurnal package photo (MEDIATEK ARM MT6993Z, date code 2521 = 2025 wk21), TechInsights (MT6993Z), Google LiteRT SDK target SocModel.MT6993 for Dimensity 9500. Google LiteRT doc page listing "MT6990" appears to be an error. Resolves conflict #15.

die_block_cpu_cluster_mm2.notes: Kurnal: CPU cluster 28.75 mm² (a 25.84 mm² variant excluding some area also shown; 18.38% of die)

die_block_c1_ultra_core_mm2.notes: Kurnal; incl. 2 MiB L2. Est. ~555M transistors.

die_block_gpu_mm2.notes: Kurnal: Mali-G1 Ultra MP12, 17.24% of die.

die_block_sme2_block_mm2_tentative.notes: Kurnal: "4 Core = 2.91 mm², 640 KiB cache, maybe SME?" — tentative identification.

process_n3e_cpp_nm.notes: N3E contacted poly pitch 48 nm (WikiChip, IEDM 2022 data); N3P is an optical shrink of N3E with compatible design rules (TSMC). Kurnal: D9500 uses N3 "2-1" ultra-HD library (cell height 143 nm, 48 nm gate pitch) on non-CPU logic and "2-2" HD library (169 nm, 48/54 nm) on CPU/NPU/GPU/IO.

process_n3e_min_metal_pitch_nm.notes: N3E minimum metal pitch 23 nm (WikiChip). N3P-specific BEOL metals (Cu vs Ru/Co liners) remain unpublished.

euv_numerical_aperture.notes: TSMC says High-NA EUV is not needed even for A16 (Reuters 2024-05-14); 3 nm-class nodes use 0.33 NA NXE scanners. High-NA (0.55) is NOT used on N3P.

boot_chain_generic_mediatek.value: BootROM (mask ROM) → Preloader (DRAM/PMIC init) → TF-A BL31 (EL3 secure monitor) + TEE (BL32) + GenieZone (EL2 hypervisor) → LK (BL33: fastboot/AVB) → Linux kernel
boot_chain_generic_mediatek.notes: Generic, publicly documented MediaTek Android boot flow; Xiaomi 17T Pro device-specific chain, memory map and firmware clocks are not published.

webgl2.value: Expected on modern Chrome Android; on-device smoke-test recommended

webgpu_chrome_android_arm.value: Chrome 121+ default on Android 12+ for ARM/Qualcomm/Intel GPUs
webgpu_chrome_android_arm.notes: Mali-G1 Ultra is an Arm GPU but is not separately named; verify navigator.gpu on device.

webgpu_mali_g1_ultra_specific.notes: Class-level ARM support is documented; this exact GPU is unconfirmed. | 2026-11-12: No per-GPU WebGPU confirmation found for Mali-G1 Ultra; gpuweb status and Chrome docs describe Android support at vendor/OS level only. The app's live WebGPU probe on the device is the only authoritative test.
webgpu_mali_g1_ultra_specific.searched_2026_11_12: gpuweb Implementation-Status wiki, Chrome WebGPU release notes, web search

conflicts.summary: Spec page 12-bit / 68 billion colors vs FAQ 68.7 billion with 8-bit. 8-bit cannot represent 68.7e9 colors.
Official spec 100% vs official FAQ 94%.
Spec Wet Touch Technology 2.0 vs FAQ wet hand touch 3.0.
FAQ names a Hexagon coprocessor (Qualcomm DSP brand) on this MediaTek phone.
Spec PD3.0/PD2.0 vs FAQ BC1.2, PD2.0, and PPS (no PD3.0).
Spec lists 22.5 W wired reverse only; FAQ lists 5 W reverse wireless. FAQ Q4 also contradicts 50 W wireless.
Official Global/UK SKUs are 12 GB only; GSMArena lists 512 GB + 16 GB.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved 2026-11-12: 16GB+512GB is a China-only SKU (IT之家); global is 12GB only.

conflicts.summary: FAQ 95.2% vs GSMArena ~91.1%.
Official 8.25 mm vs GSMArena 8.3 mm.
Official f/1.67 vs GSMArena f/1.7.
SoC page 7690×4320 vs standard/Xiaomi 7680×4320.

conflicts.topic: Vulkan 1.3 vs 1.4 on Arm comparison PDF
conflicts.summary: Arm comparison sheet still lists Vulkan 1.0–1.3 for Mali G1; Khronos and MediaTek document Vulkan 1.4.
Official in-screen only; GSMArena optical; some outlets have said ultrasonic.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved 2026-11-12: optical (Xiaomi China official 光学指纹; Notebookcheck; GSMArena).

conflicts.summary: FAQ says the phone does not support the wireless charging protocol while Q8 and the spec list 50 W wireless.
Google LiteRT lists Dimensity 9500 as MT6990; TechInsights packaging note uses MT6993Z. Not settled on a MediaTek official table in this research.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved 2026-11-12: MT6993 / package MT6993Z (Kurnal package photo, TechInsights, Google LiteRT SDK target MT6993). LiteRT doc page "MT6990" is likely an error.

conflicts.summary: Arm C1 comparison PDF lists C1-Premium L1 as 64KB/128KB; the C1-Premium TRM says 64KB 4-way L1D. TRM preferred (64KB).
5500 mm² (China launch coverage) vs 4637 mm² (unverified repair-parts blog). Neither on Xiaomi spec text.
Xiaomi markets DC dimming; Notebookcheck measured 120 Hz base + 3,846 Hz component at minimum brightness; GSMArena 3840 Hz PWM.
TechInsights/MediaTek briefing ~30B vs Kurnal cell-library estimate ~27.3B.
LLVM scheduling model states ROB 320 is copied from Neoverse V3 — not a C1-Ultra figure; do not cite.

unknowns: C1-Ultra/Premium numeric ROB entries and pipeline depth (Arm publishes only '10-wide', '~2K in flight')
Official GPU clock (1716 MHz is aggregator/die-analyst only)
NPU TOPS precision basis; NPU 990 MAC-array dimensions; 990-specific INT4/FP8 throughput
Xiaomi 17T Pro DRAM vendor / PoP stack in this specific phone
Whether the 17T Pro's UFS 4.1 device is 2- or 4-lane
OLED emitter material code (TCL CSOT supplies the panel)
Rear glass grade (GG7i on back is GSMArena-only)
Device-specific boot chain, physical memory map, GPU firmware clocks
N3P BEOL metal stack (Cu/Co/Ru) and high-k/metal-gate composition
WebGPU support confirmation for Mali-G1 Ultra specifically
iPhone 18 Pro Max 3DMark Wild Life Extreme in PhoneArena's same table

compared_as_of.notes: All three devices are officially announced and released by this date. iPhone 18 Pro Max is not UNRELEASED.

methodology.value: Official manufacturer pages preferred for hardware. Named-lab benchmarks only. Geekbench 6 never mixed with Geekbench 7. Vendor battery-hour claims are not ranked against third-party active-use tests.
methodology.notes: Full narrative, wins/losses, and caveats: head-to-head.md.

price_europe_start.notes: 12 GB + 256 GB official Europe launch price from Xiaomi pre-release material cited by Notebookcheck.

price_us_msrp.value: N/A — Xiaomi does not officially sell the 17T Pro in the US; grey-import listings ~$620–$777
price_us_msrp.notes: No official US MSRP exists (TechRadar review, PhotoWorkout). Amazon US import listings 2026-11: ~$709.50 (12/256) and ~$775 (12/512) per Notebookcheck price widget; no US warranty.

brightness_peak_nits_official.notes: UHBM at APL 25%. Not the same test as Apple 3000 outdoor or Samsung 2600 peak.

brightness_peak_nits_gsmarena_measured.notes: Independent lab; not comparable 1:1 to official UHBM.

usb.value: USB-C; included cable USB 2.0; GSMArena lists Type-C 2.0

charging_wired_w.notes: HyperCharge / PPS; Xiaomi lab ~48 min 0-100%; no in-box adapter.

endurance_gsmarena_active_use.notes: Different methodology than Apple/Samsung vendor video-hour claims.

camera_main.value: 50 MP Light Fusion 950 f/1.67 OIS 23 mm

geekbench6_single_phonearena.notes: Same-lab GB6 vs S26 Ultra 3753. Do not mix with GB7.

geekbench6_single_gsmarena.notes: Different lab; higher than PhoneArena. Still below PA S26 Ultra multi.

3dmark_snl_low_phonearena.notes: Beats S26 Ultra Low 1498 in the same lab; trails iPhone 18 Pro Max 2443.

name.notes: Announced 9 Sep 2026; pre-order 12 Sep; available 18 Sep 2026.

price_us_1tb.notes: Re-verified on live apple.com/shop (familyType iphone18promax) on 2026-11-12; 256 GB = $1,299.

3dmark_wle_high_phonearena.notes: Not in the 17T review same-table set used for Xiaomi vs Ultra. | 2026-11-12: Not found in PhoneArena's 17T Pro review table; using another lab would break same-table comparability.
